name: cura
summary: [UltiMaker Cura](https://ultimaker.com/software/ultimaker-cura/) is free, easy-to-use 3D printing software trusted by millions of users. Fine-tune your 3D model with 400+ settings for the best slicing and printing results.

ports.description: Cura desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

**Cura has a known bug that it will OOM and crash unless you set `preferences > confgure cura > Disable: crash reports, updates, notifications`, this is a hard requirement or it will OOM.**
